score.edition: 1797 second edition, Volume 1, No.19 Das Ballett, printed p.6 / PDF p.10

recording.catalogueNumber: Modern performance listing No.18; historical score No.19

identityCheck.method: Chromium Web Audio decodeAudioData at 44100 Hz; first 8 seconds inspected with Hann-windowed FFT (32768-point transform), compared to the printed opening score.
identityCheck.conclusion: The opening pickup and both-hand pitch patterns establish that the differently numbered historical score and modern recording are the same composition.
identityCheck.limits: This is score/audio frequency verification, not ear listening, a performance-quality assessment, full note-by-note audio transcription, or time-to-bar alignment. Repeats and ornament realization may differ. The audio bytes are unchanged.

difficulty.evidence: RCM Piano Syllabus 2022, Level 1 List A, The Ballet, printed p.21.
